diagnosis: Byte-exact decode inversion is not a tokenizer contract and is not required by model continuation. The actual invariant is that exact literal prefix text re-encodes to the identical prefix token IDs.

correction.change: Replace decoder byte-inversion assertion with exact literal-prefix re-encoding equality.
